title: Rawframe architecture conformance findings document
description: The canonically ordered machine-readable output of one rf-archcheck invocation. SPEC-0044 fixes the grammar. Findings are a correctness gate and participate in no ADR-0019 evidence chain.

policyVersion.description: The corpus value. A result that does not name the rules that produced it cannot be compared with another result.

findings.description: Ordered by ruleId, then subject, then position, ascending, with a total order and no ties. Iteration order, filesystem order, and hash order never reach these bytes.

authority.description: Copied from the rule, so a reader never has to hold the corpus to know which document was violated.

subject.description: The repository-relative path, or the module or target identifier, normalized with forward slashes.

position.description: Present only where the subject is a file and the rule has a position. Absent, never zero, when there is none.

detail.description: One sentence naming what was found, containing the observed value. A detail that restates the rule title adds nothing.
